# goslop text fixture — log-only emit failure stays reportable
# (WeThePeople / CourtScrapper log-and-continue TPs)
lang: python
file: bad_handler.py
---
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class SwallowHandler:
    def emit(self, record):
        try:
            self._inner.emit(record)
        except Exception:
            logger.error("emit failed")
